notes: Compact tabletop/desktop unit (aluminum extrusion chassis with 3/8" BSW mic-stand thread) — not rack-mountable, so rackUnits omitted. Two locking etherCON connectors form an integrated Gigabit Dante network switch; Network 1 also carries PoE (802.3af Class 0) as an alternate to the DC barrel power input — both are listed but they are two power options for one device rather than simultaneous separate inputs. Port labels "Network 1/2", "Line Out L/R", "Headphone", and "DC In" are inferred plain-English labels consistent with the user manual's rear-panel description (manual PDF text could not be parsed directly, so exact silkscreen wording is not 100% confirmed, though connector types/counts/specs are corroborated across the manufacturer product page, manufacturer user manual, and ManualsLib mirror of the manual).

ports.name: Network 1
ports.note: Locking etherCON/RJ45, integrated Gigabit switch port; also accepts PoE (IEEE 802.3af Class 0) as an alternate power source

ports.name: Network 2
ports.note: Locking etherCON/RJ45, integrated Gigabit switch port for daisy-chaining

ports.name: Line Out L
ports.note: Balanced analogue line output, software-switchable 0dBFS reference +18/+24dBu

ports.name: Line Out R
ports.note: Balanced analogue line output, software-switchable 0dBFS reference +18/+24dBu

ports.name: Headphone
ports.note: Front-panel 1/4" stereo headphone jack, drives 32-600 ohm loads

ports.name: DC In
ports.note: 12V DC, 1.2A via included external plugtop PSU (alternative to PoE on Network 1)
